method: Static classification from the deterministic route/API census (71 routes, 319 endpoints) + the P20 consumer graph + existing deterministic test evidence. Browser-runtime confirmation of each element is a separate gate (MPA1_BROWSER_RESULTS.json); model-dependent runtime (Pierre generating real answers) is BLOCKED by insufficient_quota this pass and is marked as such, never assumed working.

classificationLegend.ACTIVE_AND_WIRED: UI + API + deterministic evidence of end-to-end wiring (excluding the model layer where applicable)
classificationLegend.ACTIVE_PARTIAL: structurally wired but one real layer (usually the OpenAI model layer) is unproven this pass
classificationLegend.UI_ONLY: a rendered surface with no proven backing execution
classificationLegend.API_ONLY: an endpoint with no user-facing surface
classificationLegend.EXTERNAL_WORKSTREAM: owned+committed by the CloneChat workstream (commit 700ed5b8), not re-certified here
